description.en: Reads a temporary byte flag. Temporary byte flags are a table of byte values (0 to 255) in the flag data, right after the temporary bit flags; 128 bytes fit before the next table. The number is not checked.

The byte value, 0 to 255 (0 if the flag data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Reading a counter (not found in script_clean/; invented)
